email.description: Homeowner email. The domain is MX-verified.

phone.description: 10-digit US phone number; formatting characters are accepted.

message.description: Human-readable; safe to relay to the user.

address.description: Street address where the tree work is needed.

details.description: Anything the crew should know: tree size, access, hazards.
details.example: 30ft pine leaning toward the house after the storm.

dry_run.description: When true, runs full validation and photo hosting but sends no lead email. For review testing.

idempotency_key.description: REQUIRED. Unique per quote request — retries with the same key return the original response instead of creating a duplicate lead.

photo_base64.description: Optional tree photo as base64 (JPEG/PNG, under 5 MB). Hosted temporarily and auto-deleted after 72h.

urgency.description: How soon the work is needed.

confirmation.description: Human-readable confirmation to relay to the user.

lead_id.description: Our reference for this quote request.

connectorToken.description: Scoped token Meta stores with the connector config. Sent as Authorization: Bearer <token>.
connectorToken.name: Authorization

info.description: Merchant-style connector for Onslow Tree Removal (Jacksonville / Onslow County, NC). Lets the Muse agent check coverage and submit tree-service quote requests on a homeowner's behalf. Full connector descriptor: https://onslowtreeremoval.com/muse-connector/manifest.json
info.title: Onslow Tree Removal — Muse Connector API

post.description: Submit a tree-service quote request (a sales lead) on the homeowner's behalf. The only side effect is one lead email to the business inbox — no charges, no bookings. idempotency_key is required so agent retries never create duplicate leads. Pass dry_run: true to validate without sending.

get.description: Which towns in Onslow County, NC are covered.
List the tree services offered, with contact info.
